svg.title: Coder: System 1 in front, only the hard parts go to the big model
svg.desc: The same three messages now stop at a ring of quick decisions around a smaller big model: route, brief, trim, gate, notes, and check. Two messages hop out to nearby answers on an outer ring, such as your code and the commands, without reaching the model. Only the fix goes on to the center. Below: $1.84 per accepted fix instead of $4.00, and a 121 second median instead of 284.
svg.text: Send only the hard parts on.
